course.title: Medicine BMBS | University of Nottingham
quotes: Duration 5 years full-time Location Queen's Medical Centre Select start date September 2027
The entrance requirements listed apply to 2027 entry.
AAA: must include biology (or human biology) and chemistry.
34 points overall including HL6 in biology, HL6 in chemistry or 6,6,6 in 3 HL Certificates with HL 6 in biology, HL6 in chemistry
IELTS 7.5 (no less than 7.0 in any element)
All applicants must sit the UCAT in the same year as the application is made for the course. Applicants who achieve a UCAT SJT grade of Band 4 will not be considered for this course.
All applicants are required to attend an interview during the year in which they apply before an offer can be made for the course.
International applicants will be invited to attend an interview online via Microsoft Teams
